Trigger.Name: PRE-FORM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 qms$event_form('PRE-FORM');
END;

BEGIN
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(BUILTIN_DATE_FORMAT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS');
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(PLSQL_DATE_FORMAT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS');
 FORMS_DDL('ALTER SESSION SET NLS_DATE_FORMAT = ''YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS''');
END;

 DECLARE
 rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 gc_kod GROUPCOLUMN;
 gc_nev GROUPCOLUMN;
BEGIN
 rendeles_globals.activate := FALSE;
 rg_id := CREATE_GROUP('RG_ALLAPOT');
 gc_kod := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id, 'KOD', CHAR_COLUMN, 80);
 gc_nev := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id, 'NEV', CHAR_COLUMN, 80);
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id, 1);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_kod, 1, 'U');
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_nev, 1, 'Új');
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id, 2);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_kod, 2, 'L');
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_nev, 2, 'Lezárt');
END;

DECLARE
 v_ev param_tabla.ertek%TYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT ertek
 INTO v_ev
 FROM param_tabla
 WHERE kod = 'AKT_EV';

 :CTRL.MODUS := 'U';
 :CTRL.EV := v_ev;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CTRL.EV', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CTRL.EV', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('CTRL.EV', VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'VA_DISPLAY');
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF ank_jog.irhat THEN
 COMMIT_FORM;
 ank_naplo.mentes(:RENDELES.ID,
 :RENDELES.STATUSZ,
 :RENDELES.VEVO);
 :CTRL.UTOLSO := :RENDELES.STATUSZ;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:

 qms$event_item('WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED');
END;
BEGIN
 VALIDATE(ITEM_SCOPE);
 IF NOT FORM_SUCCESS THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 :CTRL.MODUS := 'K';
 GO_BLOCK('RENDELES');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 al_id ALERT;
 al_button NUMBER;
BEGIN
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('KERDES');
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY(al_id, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, 'Biztosan lezárja a rendelést?');
 al_button := SHOW_ALERT(al_id);
 IF al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 UPDATE rendeles SET statusz = 'L' WHERE id = :RENDELES.ID;
 :RENDELES.STATUSZ := 'L';
 ELSE
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

Block.Name: RENDELES
Block.WhereClause:
WHERE (
RENDELES.STATUSZ IN ( SELECT KOD FROM STATUSZ_KODTAR )
)

Trigger.Name: POST-CHANGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT nev INTO :RENDELES.VEVO_NEV FROM vevo WHERE kod = :RENDELES.VEVO;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN :RENDELES.VEVO_NEV := NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT rendeles_seq.NEXTVAL
 INTO :RENDELES.ID
 FROM DUAL;

 INSERT INTO rendeles r
 ( r.id,
 r.vevo,
 r.datum,
 r.statusz,
 r.osszeg )
 VALUES
 ( :RENDELES.ID,
 :RENDELES.VEVO,
 :RENDELES.DATUM,
 :RENDELES.STATUSZ,
 :RENDELES.OSSZEG );

 DECLARE
 v_max rendeles.osszeg%TYPE;
 BEGIN
 SELECT MAX(r2.osszeg)
 INTO v_max
 FROM rendeles r2
 WHERE r2.vevo = :RENDELES.VEVO;
 IF v_max > 1000000 THEN
 naplo_init('NAGY');
 END IF;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-UPDATE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 UPDATE rendeles r
 SET r.statusz = :RENDELES.STATUSZ,
 r.osszeg = :RENDELES.OSSZEG
 WHERE r.id = :RENDELES.ID AND
 ( r.statusz || 'x' != :RENDELES.STATUSZ || 'x' OR
 r.osszeg || 'x' != :RENDELES.OSSZEG || 'x' );
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dummy CHAR(1);

 CURSOR c_tetel IS
 SELECT 1 FROM rendeles_tetel t
 WHERE t.rendeles_id = :RENDELES.ID;

BEGIN

 OPEN c_tetel;
 FETCH c_tetel INTO dummy;
 IF ( c_tetel%FOUND ) THEN
 MESSAGE('A rendeléshez tételek tartoznak.');
 CLOSE c_tetel;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CLOSE c_tetel;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :TETEL.MENNYISEG > 1000 THEN
 MESSAGE('Túl nagy mennyiség.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

Block.Name: PARTNER
Block.WhereClause:
WHERE PARTNER.NEV LIKE '%' || NVL(:CTRL.SZURO, '%')
 AND PARTNER.TIPUS = :GLOBAL.CG$APP
 AND PARTNER.ERVENYES_TOL <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_STATUSZ
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: SELECT kod, nev FROM statusz_kodtar ORDER BY kod

ProgramUnit.Name: RENDELES_PKG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE rendeles_pkg IS
 g_utolso NUMBER;
 PROCEDURE ujraszamol;
END rendeles_pkg;

ProgramUnit.Name: RENDELES_PKG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY rendeles_pkg IS
 PROCEDURE ujraszamol IS
 v_sum NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(mennyiseg) INTO v_sum FROM rendeles_tetel WHERE rendeles_id = :RENDELES.ID;
 :RENDELES.OSSZEG := v_sum;
 g_utolso := v_sum;
 MESSAGE('Újraszámolva: ' || v_sum);
 END ujraszamol;
END rendeles_pkg;

ProgramUnit.Name: BLOKK_FRISSIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE blokk_frissit IS
BEGIN
 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK = 'RENDELES' THEN
 :CTRL.UTOLSO := :RENDELES.STATUSZ;
 END IF;
END;
